versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Woodland coots and beavers share one water Level that both players' front rows drown in each fight.
Coots float, beavers' Dikes keep neighbours dry, and cards pay gold and stats each time the Level is raised or drained.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled how votes count: every step that moves the Level is one Raise or Drain, blocked steps do nothing, and card-made Floods are Floods; Kees, Kobus, Sluice Keeper and Hendrika now say so on the card.
Own and committee ideas: Bench Coot also Raises when sold, Winter Raft pays at Level 0 (frozen canals) to link Dry Polder to coots, and the Pup stops only your own Floods so the slot puzzle lasts.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled votes during a fight: they pay like any other and keep permanent stats, the end-of-fight reset triggers nothing, and Nine Mills, Hendrika and Tail-Slapper (only above Level 0) now say so.
Sluice Keeper may Raise or Drain (gold on a Drain) to be a swing piece, and Inspecting Heemraad says it feeds the front row from behind.
